question:
The import and export of a country (in lakhs rupees) during a certain period of time is given in the following bar-graph.

Read the bar-graph carefully and answer the following question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5fb00a0f935b07f951824587def07a5ef4e610d153609b367f578cbf16de4c7.png] 

What is the percentage increment in import during the year 2016-17 as compared to the year 2015-16? (correct up to two decimals)
solution:
**Given:**

Import in 2016-17 = 1200

Import in 2015-16 = 738

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Increament)/(Previous)×100

**Calculations:**

According to the formula,

⇒ Increment = 1200 - 738 = 462

⇒ Percentage = (462)/(738)×100 = 62.60%

**⇒ Hence, The percentage increased is 62.60%**
